content: Hi all, we (@Chris Birkbeck, @William Coram, @Samuel Yin, @Shaun Stevens, and me) run our weekly Lean meetings in the University of East Anglia, which I have decided to call East AngLEAN. This is every Tuesday from 11am to 12pm throughout term "in the style of London Learning Lean" where we spend 10-20 minutes talking about something Lean-related. If anyone in East Anglia (i.e. Norfolk, Suffolk, Cambridgeshire, and Essex) or beyond is interested in coming, we'd be happy to have you! So far we've only done this internally the past year but we thought we'd open it to anyone. :slight_smile:
Next week we will be in Zicer 0.04
(Just to be clear the name choice has nothing to do with my surname: someone told me right after I posted this)
